```{r peak alignment clustering}
## If peak alignment method is clustering
if (peak_alignment_method == "clustering") {
  
  ## Handling of multiple intensities aggregating to one cluster centroid: "sumints" or "maxint"
  clust_int_method  <-  "sumints" 
  
  ## Make vector of all sample m/z
  all_mz <- sort(unlist(
    lapply(spectra_list, function(y)
      lapply(y, function(x)
        round(x$mass, 3)))))
  
  names(all_mz) <- all_mz
  
  ## Cluster peaks into centroids
  tree <- fcluster(all_mz)
  clust_mz <- fcutree(all_mz, tree, h=clust_h)
  clustMZ <- sort(clust_mz$cen)
  
  ## Match cluster centroids to sample peaks
  clusterMatrixList <- lapply(spectra_list, function(x, y, z, w) 
    get_cluster_matrix(x, y, z, w), y=clustMZ, z = clust_h, w = clust_int_method)
  
  preprocList <- lapply(clusterMatrixList, function(x) as.matrix(get_data_matrix_clustering(x)))
  
  aligned_spectra <- do.call(rbind, preprocList)
  
  colnames(aligned_spectra) <- clustMZ
  rownames(aligned_spectra) <- sample_names
  
  ## FILTER #3: REMOVE RARE/UNCOMMON PEAKS PRESENT < 10% SAMPLES
  mz_count_filter <- colSums(aligned_spectra != 0) > as.integer(nrow(aligned_spectra)*0.10)
  aligned_spectra <- aligned_spectra[, mz_count_filter]
  
  filtered_mz <- clustMZ[mz_count_filter]
  
  ## Which sample peaks form the clusters
  clusters_df <- data.frame(cluster_id = clust_mz$cluster_index,
                            all_mz = all_mz)
  
  temp_a <- data.frame(clust_centroid = clust_mz$centroid, 
                       cluster_id = unique(clust_mz$cluster_index)[order(unique(clust_mz$cluster_index))])
  
  clusters_df <- merge(clusters_df, temp_a, by = "cluster_id")
  rm(temp_a)
  
  ## Remove duplicate rows of same cluster, mz, and centroid
  clusters_df <- clusters_df[!duplicated(clusters_df), ]
  
  ## only keep filtered_mz in min_max_clusters df
  clusters_df <- clusters_df[which(clusters_df$clust_centroid %in% filtered_mz), ]
  
  ## min and max for each centroid
  clusters_df <- clusters_df %>%
    group_by(cluster_id) %>%
    summarise(
      centroid = first(clust_centroid),
      min_mass = min(all_mz),
      max_mass = max(all_mz)
    )
  
  ## FILTER #4: REMOVE BACKGROUND PEAKS (IF BACKGROUND FILE PRESENT)
  if (!is.na(background_file)) {
    
    ## Check file extension
    if (file_ext(background_file) == "xlsx") {
      bg_mz <- data.frame(mass = unlist(read_excel(background_file)))
    } else if (file_ext(background_file) == "csv") {
      bg_mz <- data.frame(mass = unlist(read.csv(background_file, header = TRUE)))
    } else {
      print("Background file extension not recognized")
    }
    
    ## match bg_mz to cluster centroid
    bg_centroids <- sqldf("SELECT clusters_df.centroid, bg_mz.*
          FROM bg_mz,clusters_df
          WHERE bg_mz.mass BETWEEN clusters_df.min_mass AND clusters_df.max_mass")
    
    ## Remove peaks from aligned_spectra that are in bg_mz_centroid
    bg_ind <- which(filtered_mz %in% unique(bg_centroids$centroid))
    
    filtered_mz <- filtered_mz[-c(bg_ind)]
    aligned_spectra <- aligned_spectra[, -c(bg_ind)]
    
    ## only keep filtered_mz in min_max_clusters df
    clusters_df <- clusters_df[which(clusters_df$centroid %in% filtered_mz), ]
  }
}
```

```{r peak alignment binning}
if (peak_alignment_method == "binning") {
  features <- mode_binning(spectra_list = spec)
  feature_mean_or_mode <- "mean"
  aligned_spectra <- bin_spectra(spectra_list = spec, features, type = feature_mean_or_mode, class_df = class_df)
  filtered_mz <- switch(feature_mean_or_mode,
                        mean = features$mean_mz,
                        mode = features$mode_mz)
}
```

```{r peak alignment feature list}
if (peak_alignment_method == "featurelist") {
  
  feature_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(feature_file, sheet = "Sheet1", skip = 1)
  #features <- unlist(read_excel(feature_file, col_names = TRUE)[,1])
  features <- feature_df %>%
    filter(annotation_method == "MS2") %>%
    pull(mz) %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  ## subset features between mass range
  features <- features[features >= mass_range[1] & features <= mass_range[2]]
  
  matched_spec <-  feature_list_alignment(spectra_list = spec, target_mz = features, ppm = ppm_error, handle_dups = "sum")
  
  aligned_spectra <- bind_rows(matched_spec, .id = "sample_name") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = target_mz, values_from = intensity, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")
  
  filtered_mz <- features
}
```

```{r normalization}
xall <- as.matrix(normalize_pixel(aligned_spectra, normalization_method))
```

``` {r bin labels}
## Function to find closest peak to selected label
get_closest_peak_labels <- function(
  data,
  target_mz,
  abundance_col,
  tolerance = 0.05
) {

  abundance_col <- rlang::ensym(abundance_col)

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      levels(data$sample_name),
      function(samp) {

        sample_data <- data %>%
          filter(sample_name == samp)

        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            target_mz,
            function(target) {

              closest_peak <- sample_data %>%
                mutate(
                  target_mz = target,
                  mz_difference = abs(mz - target)
                ) %>%
                slice_min(
                  mz_difference,
                  n = 1,
                  with_ties = FALSE
                )

              ## Only retain match if within tolerance
              closest_peak %>%
                filter(mz_difference <= tolerance) %>%
                transmute(
                  sample_name,
                  target_mz,
                  mz,
                  abundance = !!abundance_col,

                  ## Label with actual binned m/z
                  mz_label = sprintf("%.3f", mz),

                  mz_difference
                )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

```

``` {r spectrum}
## Manually select samples
selected_samples <- c(
  "MSSA_11_MeOH_20220802",
  "MSSA_52_MeOH_20230127",
  "MSSA_69_MeOH_20230904",
  "MSSA_134_MeOH_20240309",
  "MSSA_139_MeOH_20250110"
)

## Confirm these samples are present
missing_samples <- setdiff(selected_samples, rownames(xall))
if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following selected samples were not found in xall:\n",
    paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

selected_matrix <- xall[selected_samples, , drop = FALSE]

## Convert selected spectra from matrix format to long format
dd <- as.data.frame(selected_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample_name,
    names_to = "mz",
    values_to = "intensity"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mz = as.numeric(mz),

    ## Preserve the manually specified sample order
    sample_name = factor(
      sample_name,
      levels = selected_samples
    )
  ) %>%

  ## Convert each spectrum separately to relative abundance
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
    mutate(
      relative_abundance = intensity / max(intensity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%

  ## Remove missing/nonfinite values, if present
  filter(
    is.finite(mz),
    is.finite(relative_abundance)
  )


## Optional: shorter labels for the facet strips
sample_labels <- c(
  "MSSA_11_MeOH_20220802"   = "MSSA 9 | August 2022",
  "MSSA_52_MeOH_20230127"  = "MSSA 52 | January 2023",
  "MSSA_69_MeOH_20230904"  = "MSSA 69 | September 2023",
  "MSSA_134_MeOH_20240309" = "MSSA 134 | March 2024",
  "MSSA_139_MeOH_20250110" = "MSSA 139 | January 2025"
)

sample_label_df <- tibble(
  sample_name = factor(
    selected_samples,
    levels = selected_samples
  ),
  label = unname(sample_labels[selected_samples]),
  x = 990,
  y = 100
)

## Common formatting used by both panels
spectrum_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    axis.ticks.length = unit(2.5, "mm"),

    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 13
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    strip.text.y = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 11,
      face = "bold",
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0
    ),

    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.7, "lines"),

    legend.position = "none",

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 8,
      b = 10,
      l = 8
    )
  )

label_mz_full <- c(128.035, 146.046, 187.109, 191.020, 245.060, 693.471, 721.503)

label_mz_lipid <- c(693.471, 721.503)

label_tolerance <- 0.05

manual_peaks_full <- get_closest_peak_labels(
  data = dd,
  target_mz = label_mz_full,
  abundance_col = relative_abundance,
  tolerance = label_tolerance
)


## Left panel: complete m/z range 100-1000
p_full <- ggplot(
  dd %>% filter(mz >= 100, mz <= 1000),
  aes(
    x = mz,
    y = relative_abundance
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      xend = mz,
      y = 0,
      yend = relative_abundance
    ),
    linewidth = 0.22,
    color = "black",
    lineend = "butt"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = manual_peaks_full,
    aes(x = mz, y = abundance, label = mz_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = -0.25,
    size = 2.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(sample_name)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(100, 1000),
    breaks = seq(100, 1000, by = 100),
    minor_breaks = seq(150, 950, by = 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 115),
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100),
    minor_breaks = NULL,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Full Mass Spectrum",
    x = expression(italic(m/z)),
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  spectrum_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 20,
      b = 10,
      l = 8
    )
  )

## Re-normalize lipid region so the most intense peak
## between m/z 600-1000 is 100% for each sample
dd_lipid <- dd %>%
  filter(mz >= 600, mz <= 1000) %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  mutate(
    lipid_relative_abundance =
      relative_abundance / max(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

manual_peaks_lipid <- get_closest_peak_labels(
  data = dd_lipid,
  target_mz = label_mz_lipid,
  abundance_col = lipid_relative_abundance,
  tolerance = label_tolerance
)
```
